title: RiskQuote
description: Signed risk quote produced by the Python risk engine (quant/) and consumed by RiskEscrow.createEscrow() via RiskQuoteVerifier.sol (contracts/RiskQuoteVerifier.sol). Field set and EIP-712 struct are implemented as of Phase B; `signature` is produced by signing this struct (minus `signature` itself) under the EIP-712 domain {name: "AskGeneRiskEscrow", version: "1", chainId, verifyingContract: <RiskEscrow address>}. The risk engine (volatility/VaR/collateral pricing) is Phase D (quant/src/askgene_quant/{risk,policy,quotes}/); EIP-712 signing and the request-a-quote service are Phase E (quant/src/askgene_quant/signing/, quant/src/askgene_quant/service/).

quote_id.description: Maps to the on-chain bytes32 quoteId (e.g. keccak256 of this UUID). Single-use - RiskEscrow rejects replays.

depositor.description: Address that must call createEscrow and fund the collateral; binds the quote to one depositor.

counterparty.description: Address that receives the payout on settlement; binds the quote to one counterparty.

settlement_asset.description: ERC-20 token address, or the zero address for the chain's native asset.

notional.description: Fixed-point decimal string, 18 decimals (matches on-chain uint256). The contractual amount the counterparty is owed on settlement, before the platform fee.

required_collateral.description: Fixed-point decimal string, 18 decimals (matches on-chain uint256). Must be >= notional; the engine prices the difference as a risk buffer. On settlement, only notional-minus-fee goes to the counterparty and the buffer (required_collateral - notional) is returned to the depositor - it is not counterparty income.

quote_expiration.description: Deadline for using this quote to create an escrow; checked against block.timestamp on-chain. Governs quote acceptance only - see settlement_horizon for the resulting escrow's own settlement window.

settlement_horizon.description: Duration in seconds (e.g. 86400 for 1 day), bound into the signed quote. On-chain, the escrow's settlement_deadline = createdAt + settlement_horizon; the escrow becomes refundable once that deadline passes unsettled. Independent of quote_expiration. The engine will offer discrete horizons (1d/7d/14d/30d, etc), each priced with its own required_collateral.

risk_snapshot_hash.description: keccak256 hash of the risk snapshot the quote was priced from

signature.description: EIP-712 signature over the fields above, produced with the risk oracle's signing key
